messages:
maria: quick heads-up — noticed a subtle correctness/ordering issue when routing between FP8 and INT4 attention kernels in a mixed-precision canary. outputs skewed (sampling bias) even though token probs earlier look fine.

alan: can you paste the minimal repro/logs? is this only when switching mid-seq or when model variant swapped between requests?

maria: switching mid-conversation (same sess id). logs show kv cache shape/stride differences. snippet: 
```
[INFO] step=125 model=galva-7b variant=int4->fp8
kv.shape=(2,64,128) vs expected (2,32,128)
warning: kv_offset mismatch
```

raj: hmm sounds like aliasing in kv layout. we currently assume identical kv packing for fallback-compatible variants. if int4 uses packed strides we might be reading wrong offsets when fp8 resumes.

sophia: could also be that dequant-fusion path uses a different kv-quant-scale map stored per-model, not per-session. switching variant replaces the map but runtime reuses the cached kv buffer.

maria: exactly. reproducer: send sequence A with int4, then issue a context-extend call with fp8 fallback. observed next-token probs change by ~0.12 KL.

alan: short-term mitigation: runtime should flush/rehash KV when precision variant changes for a session. cost is latency hit but avoids corrupt decode. long-term: handshake / precision-hint to ensure kernel selection preserves compatibility.

carla: +1. also want telemetry: increment a metric when a session experiences a precision-change and record pre/post perplexity delta. that'll catch regressions in canary.

raj: proposal for handshake: add request header `x-precision-hint: "fp8|int4|mixed"` and a kernel API `kernel.handshake(session_id, hint)` that returns `compatibility: {kv_layout: v1|v2, scale_map_id}`. runtime checks equality before reusing KV.

sophia: API needs to be cheap — avoid serializing scale maps. use small opaque IDs and a monotonic version. kernels expose `kv_schema_id` at load time. runtime compares ids and either reuse or remap/flush.

maria: example HTTP header: `X-Precision-Hint: fp8,int4` or `X-Precision-Safe: true` to force conservative behavior.

alan: implementation plan: 1) kernel exports `kv_schema_id` (uint64) 2) runtime stores schema per session 3) on variant switch, compare ids -> if mismatch then either remap buffer (if adapter exists) or flush KV and emit metric. 4) add unit test for mid-seq switch.

carla: I'll add telemetry dashboards: `session.precision_switches`, `session.kv_flushes`, `session.post_switch_kl_delta`. Can we tag with `model_variant`?

raj: need fallback policy update: prefer variants with identical `kv_schema_id` for routing when SLOs allow. new routing heuristic: prefer same-schema variant within session affinity window.

runtime-bot: canary scheduled: `hybrid-precision-kv-schema-check` on infra/test-cluster at 22:00 UTC.

sophia: perf note — remapping is possible by applying scale_map transform if we store per-layer quant params. transform cost ~0.5ms/token for 7B, better than full KV regen for longer seqs. add adapter registry for known conversions.

maria: ok action items: alan -> prototype kernel `kv_schema_id` export + runtime compare (P0), sophia -> define adapter interface (P1), carla -> telemetry (P1), raj -> routing heuristic patch (P1). I'll own canary coordination.

alan: starting a draft PR, will ping when ready for review.

maria: thx everyone. tagging @sre for canary watch. :thumbsup:
